lead.reading: Pemby reads the text in your file, then builds your profile from it. Fields appear as they are found.
lead.parsed: Read from your CV. You can correct anything after you sign up.

queued.body: Pemby has reached today's limit for reading CVs. Yours keeps its place in line and will be read by {time}.
queued.bodyNoTime: Pemby has reached today's limit for reading CVs. Yours keeps its place in line and will be read as soon as reading opens again.
queued.note: You can leave this page open, or come back to it in this tab.

unreadable.body: It looks like a scan or an image, so there is no text in it to read. Paste the text of your CV below instead.
unreadable.label: Text of your CV
unreadable.hint: Copy it from your document. At least 200 characters.

failed.body: Something went wrong while building your profile. Try again, or paste the text of your CV.

errors.cv_too_large: That file is over 5 MB. Try a PDF or DOCX under 5 MB.
errors.cv_bad_type: Pemby reads PDF and DOCX files. Try one of those.
errors.cv_text_length: Paste at least 200 characters of your CV.
errors.turnstile_failed: We couldn't confirm this is a person and not a bot. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Several CVs came from here in a short time. Wait a while and try again.
errors.unavailable: Pemby can't take CVs right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.not_found: This CV is no longer here. Unclaimed CVs are deleted after 24 hours. Drop it again to start over.
errors.network: Pemby couldn't be reached. Check your connection and try again.

Cv.human: One quick check that you're a person, then your CV goes up.

teaser.checking: Checking which roles can hire you from {country}
teaser.count: {count, plural, one {role hires} other {roles hire}} from {country}
teaser.sample: {shown, plural, one {Here is one of them.} other {Here are # of them.}} Each was checked on the company's own careers page.

reasons.country-named: The post lists {country} among the places for this role.
reasons.worldwide-engagement: The post says it's open worldwide to {engagement}.
reasons.company-names-country: The company's careers page names {country}; not confirmed for this role.

reasonFallback.green: The post says where this role can be done, and {country} is included.
reasonFallback.yellow: The post's wording suggests {country} is included without saying so outright.
reasonFallback.white: The post doesn't say which countries the role is open to.

teaser.noneBody: Sign up to keep your profile and come back to it.
teaser.unsupportedBody: Pemby starts with the countries remote roles most often leave out, and {country} isn't one of them yet. Your profile is still yours to save.
teaser.noCountryTitle: Your CV doesn't say where you live
teaser.noCountryBody: Pemby matches roles by the country you work from. Your CV doesn't name one, so you can add it after you sign up.
teaser.failed: Roles couldn't be loaded right now
teaser.counterNote: Pemby counts only roles that can hire you from {country}, so this number can be zero.

save.title: Save your profile
save.body: Your CV and profile are deleted after 24 hours unless you sign up. Signing up keeps them on your account, and you can correct anything in them.

announce.teaserReady: {count, plural, =0 {No roles from {country} right now.} one {# role hires from {country}.} other {# roles hire from {country}.}}
